annotations.title: How our own API tester last found this API

description: How our own API tester last found this API: when it ran, how many of the published operations it asked, how many of its checks passed, how many regressions (checks that passed before and fail now), and the trend over recent runs. The tester asks every operation every six hours with a real subject and wrongly on purpose (missing and out-of-range parameters, unknown subjects, wrong methods, no key, a revoked key) and holds every check to a ratchet. Free. It names no failing check; a check it could not ask is never counted as passing.

runs.description: How many recent runs the trend carries, 1 to 60 (default 30).

name: api_quality

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

lastRun.description: The last run: at, build, operations {covered, total, skipped}, checks {passing, total, failing, notChecked}, regressions, knownFailing, durationSeconds, ok. Null before the first run.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

says.description: The last run in one sentence, with what it does not say.

trend.description: Recent runs, oldest first: at, checksPassing, checksTotal, operationsCovered, operationsTotal, regressions, ok.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
